ECMappingHelper.checkForDuplicatedKeys queries dic with the entire keys array rather than current key; NSDictionary allKeys has already lost duplicate insertion history. Source observation only; no Objective-C runtime reproduction.
No code copied into rrrah; remaining files and assets still require assessment.
FSElementPool caches parsed declarations by elementName; collisions overwrite entries. Recursive filename matching is header resolution, not duplicate-content detection.
readMappingForSwift tests _ocMapping and saves defaults through saveMappingForOC; source-level cross-language state bug, no runtime reproduction.
OC save refuses zero or one entries; this policy is unrelated to duplicate-file search.
Swift default snippet dictionary and SwiftMapping header are empty. Small processor subclasses provide Objective-C declaration regex patterns and element type tags; no content duplicate engine.
NSString+PDRegex header carries its own Carl Brown/PDAgent MIT notice; implementation not yet read.
FSElementPool header declares parseElementFromProjectFile while corresponding implementation was commented out in the already-read .m. No link/runtime test performed.
All 57 Objective-C .h/.m source files now read in full, Git blob verified. No file-content duplicate scanner in these sources.
Editor permits repeated shortcut keys in mappingList then collapses them through dictionary assignment on save; duplicate-key history is lost. Different domain from file deduplication.
PDRegex extraction calls substringWithRange for optional unmatched capture groups without checking NSNotFound; source-level exception risk, not runtime reproduced.
Parser uses regular expressions for declarations and methods; no complete Objective-C grammar, comment/string awareness, or AST guarantee established.
